title: Coding Club Room Layout
description: A club room floor plan where every placement is clickable -- and a draggable mentor marker that shows what facing the monitors inward actually buys you.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Telling Your Club's Story and Designing the Classroom

educational.audience: Founders and mentors setting up a room

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a blank room outline, the learner identifies where each layout element belongs and explains why its placement supports mentor supervision or safety.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click any element for its rationale; drag the mentor marker and toggle sightlines to test the supervision claim
pedagogical.assessment: Drag the mentor into a corner and ask how many screens stop being readable.
